title: Grid and FE
description: GridAndFE is a mod that adds FE-powered lamps and, in future updates, more electrical devices compatible with various FE energy mods such as Immersive Engineering, Create: Crafts & Additions, and more.
body:
GridAndFE

GridAndFE is a NeoForge Minecraft mod focused on FE-powered lamps and electrical devices designed to work with existing FE energy systems.

The mod aims to add simple, useful, and decorative electrical blocks that integrate naturally with technology and automation modpacks without requiring large industrial machines.

Current Features
FE-powered lamp block
Dynamic on/off light states
Energy storage support
Compatibility with FE energy systems
Works with mods such as:
Immersive Engineering
Create: Crafts & Additions
Thermal Series
Mekanism
Other FE-compatible mods
Why download GridAndFE?

Many FE technology mods focus mainly on machines and automation. GridAndFE focuses instead on decorative and practical electrical devices powered by FE energy.

The goal is to gradually expand the mod with:

More lamp variants
Decorative electrical devices
Connectors and power distribution blocks
Modern lighting systems
Additional FE-powered utility blocks
Development Status

GridAndFE is currently in active beta development.
